text: Bitcoin and Ethereum have both dropped 3.5% in the last 24 hours, signaling coordinated selling pressure across the two largest assets rather than isolated weakness. Fear & Greed is at 25 (Extreme Fear) and sliding further, while BTC dominance remains elevated at 56.1%, suggesting traders are rotating into Bitcoin as a relative safe haven despite the broader pullback. The 24-hour volume of $67B is moderate—not panic liquidation, but enough to confirm deliberate rebalancing rather than panic capitulation.
